notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA county list names a tower at Manetto Hill (platform, Nassau, 40.80363 -73.45383, Gone); it matches the brief record. The NY chapter alphabetical list has no Manetto entry (text search found none), so there is no build date, height, staffing or removal date. The 1959 sentence is county-wide (Nassau and Suffolk, Conservation Department withdrawal and closure of active towers); the story does not claim it applies to this platform, and the editor should decide whether to keep it. The Plainview sentences concern the hill's view and name, not the tower. The story is short because the evidence is thin. No corrections to the brief record.
